plain: To ask humbly, as in a prayer or petition

webster.text: To entreat for; to seek by earnest prayer; as, to supplicate blessings on christian efforts to spread the gospel.

example.quote: May it please your high mightinesses of Virginia to pay your just proportionate quota of our national debt : we humbly supplicate that it may please you to comply with your federal duties.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
